platforms: 42 generated track ids across train, calibration, nominal_eval, and anomalous_eval splits
provenance.coordinate_convention: WGS84 latitude/longitude in decimal degrees with altitude above mean sea level in meters.

units.timestamp: mixed ISO8601 UTC string or Unix epoch milliseconds

provenance.notes: Generated mixed-format dataset used for scaling, calibration, and tuning checks.

train.description: Synthetic nominal runs used for model fitting.

calibration.description: Synthetic nominal runs used for threshold calibration.

nominal_eval.description: Synthetic held-out nominal runs used for false-positive inspection.

anomalous_eval.description: Synthetic abnormal runs with injected disturbances used for evaluation.
